maxDecompressedSize.label: advanced
maxDecompressedSize.description: Set the maximum decompressed size of the data (in bytes). The default value if not specified corresponds to 1 gigabyte. An IOException is thrown if the decompressed size exceeds this amount. Set to -1 to disable setting a maximum decompressed size.
